items.html: And afterward the king of Netzah reigned and extended the five Hassadim into the body of Yeshsut, and when he died, the rest of the kings descended into Hod, and the posteriors of Yeshsut descended and returned the posteriors opposite the face of Tevuna. Afterward the king of Hod reigned and extended the five Gevurot into the body of Tevuna, and when he died, two kings descended into Yesod, and then the vessels of NH descended to Beria, for the two of them are only one king, as was said above, since both of them are only halves of the body, and although they reigned one after the other, nevertheless both of them are called only one king. And then the posteriors of Tevuna descended as well, and Yeshsut and Tevuna returned back to back.
